en.topic_title: New Huanggang border checkpoint opens with single-queue joint clearance system for HK and mainland authorities
en.topic_summary:
The revamped Huanggang Port border checkpoint between Hong Kong and Shenzhen has officially opened after six years of redevelopment, featuring the first joint clearance facility allowing passengers to go through Hong Kong and mainland immigration at the same time.



Chief Secretary Eric Chan (first from right) and security chief Chris Tang (second from right) inspect the new Huanggang Port on October 12, 2026. Photo: GovHK. 



The new Huanggang Port started clearance services at 6.30am on Mond
